decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Within three months of the date of this planning permission, samples of the timber panels to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the rear extension and roof hereby permitted shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (L(-)001, L(-)002, L(-)003, L(-)004, L(-)005, L(-)006, L(-)007, L(21)001 Rev B, L(21)002 Rev A, L(21)003 Rev A, L(21)004 Rev A, L(21)005 Rev A, L(21)006 Rev A, L(21)007 Rev A, L(21)008 Rev A, and Flood Risk Assessment received: 23 November 2016. BBA Certification 09/4698 for Colourcoat Urban Roof Panel received: 10 May 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The privacy screen on the roof terrace hereby permitted shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Recladding of existing roof, replacement and enlargement of existing fenestration, additional roof windows, single storey rear extension with first floor roof terrace and new boundary treatment to house.
